name: Bell
source:
Bell in child form. She is mostly using this form to conserve her magic use. Despite her looks, she is a teacher at the Magic Academy. In this form she also appears in front of her students at the academy, and as a result becomes highly popular with her students. Bell and her younger sister [url=/c112529]Piyoko[/url] share a house with the protagonist.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=4120]Getchu[/url].]
